title: Property Preservation Desk Note: Occupant Vacating Allowance on a Re-Filed Extension Request in Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases
content:
**Rule.** For a further extension request re-filed on a Cedarline Summit loan's Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases case, the most recent occupancy inspection finding on the borrower's occupancy profile (Occupancy and Residency Certification) adds days to the requested length:

- Where the finding is that the home is occupied by someone other than a borrower, 10 calendar days are added for that occupant to vacate before closing.
- Where the finding is that the home is vacant, 3 calendar days are added.
- Any other finding, or none, adds nothing.

**Same-day findings.** Where two occupancy inspection findings carry the same most recent date, a finding that the home is occupied by someone other than a borrower prevails over a finding that it is vacant, and a vacant finding prevails over any other finding.

| Most recent finding | Days added to the requested length |
|---|---|
| occupied by someone other than a borrower | 10 |
| vacant | 3 |
| other, or no finding | 0 |

## Hypothetical illustration

The latest two inspections share a date: one vacant, one of another kind. The vacant finding prevails, so 3 days are added.
